caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cradle with a rectangular body and curved, decorative edges on the side panels and ends. The cradle is colored in rich brown tones, suggesting a polished wood finish with visible wood grain patterns throughout the structure. The cradle rests on two curved rockers, which are also made of the same brown wood, and these rockers extend slightly beyond the base of the cradle at both ends. The sides have a scalloped design along the top edge, and the corners are joined with visible dovetail joints. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige, giving emphasis to the cradle at the center of the composition. The artist’s signature, “Edmond R. Coats,” appears in small letters below and to the right of the cradle.
title: Wooden Cradle
